operator_comparison.common_map_rule: For each engine pair, one single relabeling must jointly align TARGET, SUBSET and SHAM; edit-specific relabelings are forbidden.
operator_comparison.primary_obstruction: Total symmetric-difference cardinality of nonzero transition-support edges across the three edit operators after relabeling.
tie_breakers: Equal-source-state row-kernel total-variation distance on jointly occupied source states.
operator_comparison.exact_support_conjugacy: Primary obstruction = 0 under one common map.

quotient_reconstruction.universe: All 15 set partitions of the 4-state space.
quotient_reconstruction.exact_common_support_quotient: A partition whose aggregated transition-support graph is identical across all three engines separately for TARGET, SUBSET and SHAM.
quotient_reconstruction.selection: Choose the finest nontrivial exact common-support quotient (maximum number of blocks). If multiple, report all; do not select by outcome-dependent narrative preference.
quotient_reconstruction.probability_layer: After exact support matching, report operator TV distances on the quotient descriptively; support equivalence alone does not imply probabilistic equality.
quotient_reconstruction.distinguished_candidate: Hamming-weight partition {{00},{01,10},{11}} is reported explicitly but receives no privileged acceptance.

obstruction_localization: Edge present in only one engine after best admissible map

falsification.semantic_conjugacy_falsified_if: Every G_sem map leaves nonzero support obstruction for an engine pair.
falsification.arbitrary_coordinate_equivalence_falsifi: Every S4 map leaves nonzero support obstruction.
falsification.quotient_sufficiency_falsified_if: No nontrivial partition yields exact common support across all engines and edits.
falsification.universal_transport_law_ceiling: Requires one authority-bearing semantic map or one nontrivial exact common quotient shared across all engines and edit operators, plus source-separated recurrence. Development data alone cannot promote beyond DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE.
